subject: Geo-fence private deployment + audit access — exec clearance request
messages:
From: Mark O'Brien <mark.obrien@geosys.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Geo-fenced private deployment + audit window

Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — GeoSys is keen to move to a private deployment for our telemetry/PHI pipeline. Procurement asked me to send the list of non-standard asks so we can track them with legal and execs. High-level: 

- In-country deployment (US-only / geofence to us-east region) and contractual residency guarantee.
- Audit access: on-prem style audit but limited to a "2 business day" on-site/remote window per year (we're willing to provide a strict agenda).
- Operator/host access for troubleshooting: read-only session recordings only (no shell access).
- BYOK for KMS for keys that encrypt customer data (we'll require a key escrow clause).
- Egress carveout for specific third-party integrations (HIS vendor callbacks).
- We're asking for a 20% ARR discount for a 24-month committed term given integration and validation work.

Attached: GeoSys_Security_Reqs.pdf and Procurement_Termsheet.docx. Can you confirm whether Redwood is open to these exceptions and what approvals we need?

Best,
Mark
--
Mark O'Brien
Director, Cloud Integrations | GeoSys Health

Team — looping you in. Summary of external asks (from Mark): geofence US-only, 2-business-day restricted audit window, read-only operator access recordings, BYOK w/ escrow, egress carveout, and a 20% ARR discount for 24 months. See attached Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx for proposed milestones. (attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx)

Quick thoughts:
- Technical: Lauren, can infra guarantee region pinning to us-east and tenant isolation on our Private offering? Any limitations?
- Security: Rishi, can we support a 2-business-day audit window instead of the typical 5-day window if GeoSys agrees to pre-defined evidence bundles (SOC2, audit logs, snapshot access only)?
- Commercial: Marissa, the ask is a 20% discount vs our standard enterprise tier. This is outside Deal Desk parameters; we need exec clearance for concession >15% and for the egress carveout.

Requested action: Please review and reply with recommended guardrails. If we proceed with exceptions, we should surface a short exec approval packet summarizing technical mitigation, legal redlines, and recommended credit. I can host a 30-min sync with Mark next week to align.

Ava

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Geo-fenced private deployment + audit window

Ava / team — ran the asks by Security & Legal. Concise risk assessment and recommended controls for the exec packet: 

1) Geofence / Residency:
- Feasible: we can pin VMs + object storage to us-east by configuration; recommend a contractual residency SLA and a quarterly technical attestation (automated region-check report).

2) Audit window reduction to 2 business days:
- Acceptable IF: customer provides evidence checklist 10 business days in advance and we deliver a pre-specified evidence bundle (SOC2, log export, config snapshot). No shell-level interactive access; all live sessions must be recorded and limited to a read-only troubleshooting container.

3) BYOK + key escrow:
- BYOK supported, but escrow increases operational risk. Require HSM/KMS design review and an escrow-only access process (legal to negotiate limited escrow triggers).

4) Egress carveout:
- Operationally doable, but encryption keys and API callbacks must be scoped to allowed endpoints; require a narrowly-scoped contract appendix listing allowed third parties.

Commercial recommended concession: approve up to 15% ARR discount for a 24-month term without exec; for anything >15% need Exec sign-off. If we grant 20%, suggest structuring as 15% baseline + 5% earnout tied to Milestone completion (mutual action plan).

Legal redlines to expect (high priority): operator access clause, indemnity language for data processing, and escrow trigger language. Laura — can you review the legal posture and confirm the minimum non-negotiables we must keep?

If we get a quick yes on 15% + milestone credit structure and the technical guardrails above, I recommend moving to a canary private deployment with time-limited operator playbooks.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark O'Brien <mark.obrien@geosys.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@geoforce.health>
Date: 2026-10-06T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Geo-fenced private deployment + audit window — EXEC CLEARANCE

Thanks for the clear packet. I reviewed Security's recommendations and Legal's anticipated redlines. Executive decision below — approved with constraints: 

- Discount: approve up to 15% ARR discount for a 24-month committed term. Any additional 5% to reach 20% must be structured as a milestone-based rebate (documented in Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx) tied to onboarding completion and production readiness.

- Audit window: allow a maximum of 2 business days per year provided GeoSys submits the evidence checklist 10 business days prior. All sessions must be scheduled, observed, and recorded. No shell-level interactive access is permitted.

- Operator access & BYOK: BYOK permitted only after HSM/KMS review by our infra team. Operator access will be via a recorded, time-boxed jumpbox with strict RBAC; any emergency break-glass must be logged and require Legal notification.

- Egress carveout: permitted but only for a pre-approved list of third-party endpoints documented in a contract appendix. No open-ended carveouts.

- Sign-off: Legal to include a Data Processing Addendum and escrow triggers with strict scope. Require indemnity and liability language to remain as-is; no lifting of standard caps.

Marissa/Rishi — proceed to capture this decision in HubSpot and reflect the structure in the redline (15% upfront / 5% earned). Lauren — please confirm us-east pinning and provide a short implementation checklist for the packet. Ava — coordinate a customer call to walk through the guardrails and next steps; Mark / Lina, we'll target a 10/13 sync.

I am attaching a signed cover sheet for the approval to include in the deal file. (attachment: Signed_Cover_Sheet.pdf)

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal & Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
